identity_contract.statement: Registry identity binds source-declared compatibility facts (pinned filename, tokenizer pins, tensor-schema policy) to recorded evidence. It does not establish the cryptographic identity of an installed checkpoint: a matching model family, filename, tensor shape, or bpw label never implies that the currently loaded weights carry the recorded qualification. Exact pack contents are not verified by any current loader pin.

fields.exl3_exact_pack_contents: not established by current loader pins

quality_standard.description: Real-task non-inferiority with registered margins (doc/explanation/status.md, 30 Oct 2026); earlier KL results stay recorded as failures; KL is a diagnostic.

registrations.scope: A registration version applies to collections scored after it is registered. A verdict recorded under an earlier version is annotated, never re-judged.
registrations.selector: m3_quality::Registration (M3_REGISTRATION=v6|v7 in the M3 compare step); an unknown version aborts before any math

v6.applies_to: collections scored on build 82ca3d816 or 659b0028d (the 2026-11-02 P1/O1 campaign and the 2026-11-03 EXL3 4.50 run)

nll.statistic: true-token NLL difference, all scored positions

top1.statistic: top-1 accuracy difference, all scored positions

copy.statistic: exact-match rate difference (all span tokens argmax-correct)

retrieval.statistic: exact-match rate difference (all span tokens argmax-correct)

v6.known_limit: The exact-match probe gates are underpowered: with n=174 retrieval and n=387 copy probes, two equal-quality packs pass all four gates about 10% of the time (P(pass | true difference 0) about 0.19 retrieval, 0.50 copy). A probe-gate failure under v6 is inconclusive unless the point estimate is itself adverse.

v7.status: registered 2026-11-06 (Dan, option c); applies to future collections only; no data had been scored under it when it was fixed

nll.statistic: true-token NLL difference, all scored positions

top1.statistic: top-1 accuracy difference, all scored positions

copy.statistic: probe-span NLL difference: per probe the mean true-token NLL over the span, pooled probe-weighted

retrieval.statistic: probe-span NLL difference: per probe the mean true-token NLL over the span, pooled probe-weighted

secondary_reported_not_gated: exact-match rate difference, lower bound (copy and retrieval)
probe-span argmax accuracy difference, lower bound (copy and retrieval)
v7.power: On the recorded layout (174 retrieval, 387 copy probes), P(pass | true difference 0) is about 0.97 or more per probe gate and about 0.96 or more for all four gates jointly under cross-format churn; P(pass | true harm = margin) is 0.054-0.068 (nominal 0.05); P(pass | harm 0.0225 nats) is at most 0.022. Source: qualification/o1-gate-v7/ANALYSIS.md.
